$comment: The editorial half of docs/visual-audit/INVENTORY.md. scripts/build-visual-inventory.mjs owns
the mechanical half — ids, types, word counts — and merges this file over it.
MATCHING is most-specific-first: sections[tab:number].blocks[type] beats sections[tab:number].default,
which beats chapters[tab].blocks[type], which beats chapters[tab].default. A block that matches
nothing is `argument` / KEEP-PROSE. That default is deliberate: under hard rule 1, prose survives
unless somebody has decided a figure can carry its job.
ACTIONS. KEEP-PROSE stays as written. CONVERT is the only action that deletes anything, and it is
only ever applied to what rule 1a names — ASCII and pseudo-table code blocks, stacks of
near-identical cards, and 'summary' tables that restate a figure number for number. COLLAPSE keeps
every word, behind the Brief-mode disclosure or a figure's 'View the data'. DEDUPE collapses to a
CrossRef and waits for Firefly's answer to D-1 before anything is deleted. FIX is a defect.
RELATIONSHIP is the FT relationship or diagram family the block expresses. `argument` means
reasoning that no visual can carry, and the generator refuses to let an `argument` block be
CONVERTed — that check is what keeps rule 1 enforceable rather than aspirational.
